checks.name: paper_to_code_review
checks.evidence: Claims and limitations individually recorded in claim_to_code.json; PASS describes review coverage, not full scientific fidelity.

checks.name: unit_and_training_checks
checks.evidence: Six checks previously passed, including data reading, forward pass, loss, backward pass, parameter update, and save and load. The check files have since been removed; those results do not verify clinical data or the complete model.

checks.name: independent_formula_checks
checks.evidence: Previously checked the finite sum, scalar gradient, projection, and metric arithmetic; the check files have since been removed.

checks.name: clinical_dataset_training_and_results
checks.evidence: The five-centre patient data and labels are restricted; no clinical result is asserted.

checks.name: official_implementation_comparison
checks.evidence: The paper-listed release address was inaccessible when checked.

checks.name: official_datasets_read
checks.evidence: Source records were checked, but dataset files were not downloaded or read.

checks.name: full_paper_model_and_experiments
checks.evidence: The full backbone, clean codebook fitting, attacks, baselines and clinical analyses are not implemented.

checks.name: requested_minimum_4500_effective_code_lines
checks.evidence: The partial implementation is smaller than the requested minimum and the remaining paper methods have not been implemented.

checks.name: privacy_pattern_and_artifact_scan
checks.evidence: Pattern scan for common absolute paths, credentials, email addresses and prohibited wording; matches: 0. This is not proof of absence of every possible sensitive value.

checks.name: duplicate_function_body_scan
checks.evidence: Compared Python function bodies by syntax tree; exact duplicates: 0.

checks.name: markdown_and_workflow_scan
checks.evidence: Checked project tree for Markdown files and .github directories.

checks.name: requested_coverage_and_referenced_modules
checks.evidence: The model, preprocessing, full experiments and required code size remain incomplete.

engineering_defaults: The input is a CSV of externally computed, paired vectors and clinical features.
Agreement concatenates cosine similarity with the elementwise product.
Assignment uses squared Euclidean distance and temperature 1.
Task and outcome networks are small two-layer heads with hidden width 32.
Cross entropy is used as the task risk; risk for invariance uses task logits.
The aggregation mask and rank are externally supplied.
The attack success denominator excludes examples already in the target class.
not_specified: complete train-validation split and random seeds
